title: Coordinate Transformation Conversion
text: Convert to a specified coordinate transformation representation, 2 inputs, {Representation} sets Input representation Axis-Angle; {Axis rotation sequence} sets the order of Euler angle axis, {Show TrVec input port} sets the toggle TrVec port, {Show TrVec output port} sets the toggle TrVec port and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input transformation
ports.summary: Coordinate transformation column vector | 3-by-3 matrix | 4-by-4 matrix

ports.name: Output transformation
ports.summary: Coordinate transformation column vector | 3-by-3 matrix | 4-by-4 matrix

params.name: Representation
params.values: Input representation Axis-Angle | Euler Angles | Homogeneous Transformation | Quaternion | Rotation Matrix | Translation Vector

params.name: Axis rotation sequence
params.values: Order of Euler angle axis rotations ZYX (default) | ZYZ | XYZ

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
